And since a thread was made for the Void Guard, I figure we could use one for this new reveal as well!

MindWanderer:

 According to the wiki, Dark Watch #4 is part of the OblivAeon arc. 

I do not think this is true at all.

Couple of things. Christopher recently mentioned in the PT forum that the DW book is very slow moving and its releases are not exactly monthly that they could possibly be longer. Harpy doesn't come into the Dark Watch until DW#7 as we saw in the ARG, and she was part of the group a fair amount of time before the Oblivaeon event. In fact, I'm fairly confident she was in the DW during the Progeny event, which was almost a year before Oblivaeon (if we go by Freedom Five Annuals being yearly on the dot).

Also since we are talking about Dark Watch books, we can see DW#2 cover from the Hero CHallenge document. Judging by the cover alone, it's possibly centered around Gloomweaver (pure assumption based on the skull at the bottom) and is also called an Annual.

Also worth noting that DW#18 is actually the issue Be The Gate from the ARG as well! So the fact that Lifeline and Skinnwalker are in such a huge issue is extremely strange! Does that but Skinnwalker event smack dab in the middle of all the Oblivaeon stuff? @Christopher, is this a potential oversight on issue numbers or is that flavor text from Lifeline actually from DW#18?
